name: midivolt
stdout:
usage: midivolt [-h] {create,arrange,analyze,transcribe} ...

MIDIVOLT MIDI tools

positional arguments:
  {create,arrange,analyze,transcribe}

    arrange             Add accompaniment without editing input tracks
    analyze             Print a MIDI summary and estimated key
    transcribe          Audio-to-MIDI using optional Basic Pitch

name: midivolt-ai
stdout:
usage: midivolt-ai [-h] --provider {openai,ollama} --model MODEL --prompt
                   PROMPT --out OUT [--input INPUT] [--manifest MANIFEST]
                   [--lock LOCK]
                   [--parts {chords,melody,bass,drums} [{chords,melody,bass,drums} ...]]
                   [--bars BARS] [--bpm BPM] [--key KEY]
                   [--mode {minor,major}] [--seed SEED] [--endpoint ENDPOINT]
                   [--allow-remote-endpoint] [--api-key-env API_KEY_ENV]
                   [--allow-network] [--timeout TIMEOUT]

MIDIVOLT opt-in provider API -> independently editable MIDI. This is genuine
network-capable AI inference when --allow-network is used with a real
provider/model. There are no user credentials bundled; offline tests use a
fake response/loopback server, not an AI checkpoint. Existing MIDI is never
modified, and AI proposals need explicit review.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --provider {openai,ollama}
  --model MODEL         Provider model ID or locally installed Ollama tag
  --prompt PROMPT
  --out OUT             NEW .mid file, source MIDI never overwritten
  --input INPUT         Existing MIDI for safe continuation
  --manifest MANIFEST   Review manifest required when --input is used
  --lock LOCK           Explicit source track lock; default locks ALL source
                        tracks
  --parts {chords,melody,bass,drums} [{chords,melody,bass,drums} ...]
  --bars BARS
  --bpm BPM
  --key KEY
  --mode {minor,major}
  --seed SEED
  --endpoint ENDPOINT   Optional explicit HTTPS/loopback API endpoint
  --allow-remote-endpoint
                        Authorize sending prompts/key to non-default remote
                        HTTPS endpoint
  --api-key-env API_KEY_ENV
                        ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE NAME; never put key itself on
                        command line
  --allow-network       EXPLICIT consent to call selected AI provider
  --timeout TIMEOUT

name: midivolt-prompt
stdout:
usage: midivolt-prompt [-h] --prompt PROMPT --out OUT [--input INPUT]
                       [--bars BARS] [--bpm BPM] [--key KEY]
                       [--mode {major,minor}]
                       [--parts {chords,melody,bass,drums} [{chords,melody,bass,drums} ...]]
                       [--seed SEED] [--overwrite]

MIDIVOLT text instruction -> editable MIDI baseline. Unlike an LLM music
generator, this is a *deterministic* local arrangement sketcher. Audio-to-MIDI
and provider-based AI are separate capabilities. No third-party trademarks or
weights are used.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prompt PROMPT       e.g. '8 bars of sparse melody in D minor at 110 bpm'
  --out OUT             New Standard MIDI file path
  --input INPUT         Existing Standard MIDI to extend non-destructively
  --bars BARS           Override number of generated bars (1..32)
  --bpm BPM             Override tempo, or match source MIDI BPM
  --key KEY             Pitch class, e.g. D, F#, Bb
  --mode {major,minor}
  --parts {chords,melody,bass,drums} [{chords,melody,bass,drums} ...]
                        Which separate MIDI parts to generate
  --seed SEED           Stable 32-bit seed for variations
  --overwrite

name: midivolt-transcribe
stdout:
usage: midivolt-transcribe [-h] --input INPUT --output OUTPUT
                           [--stem-type {bass,guitar,keys,vocal,other,drums}]
                           [--drum-engine {off,dsp}] [--tempo TEMPO]
                           [--onset-threshold ONSET_THRESHOLD]
                           [--frame-threshold FRAME_THRESHOLD]
                           [--min-note-ms MIN_NOTE_MS] [--overwrite]

MIDIVOLT: batch pitched WAV stems to aligned MIDI tracks.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT         single WAV or folder with stems
  --output OUTPUT       directory for MIDI and report
  --stem-type {bass,guitar,keys,vocal,other,drums}
                        override filename for a single WAV
  --drum-engine {off,dsp}
                        opt-in kick/snare/hat detection; no pretrained models
  --tempo TEMPO         MIDI grid BPM; does not quantize notes
  --onset-threshold ONSET_THRESHOLD
  --frame-threshold FRAME_THRESHOLD
  --min-note-ms MIN_NOTE_MS
  --overwrite

name: midivolt-tsov
stdout:
usage: midivolt-tsov [-h] --python PYTHON --root ROOT [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                     {projects,tools,status,history,undo,redo,edit,tempo} ...

Call separately installed tsov MCP. Writes require --apply.

positional arguments:
  {projects,tools,status,history,undo,redo,edit,tempo}
    projects            List tsov projects
    tools               List permitted MCP tools offered by tsov
    edit                Apply LLM edit to one selected track
    tempo               Change project BPM

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --python PYTHON       tsov Python 3.12 virtualenv executable
  --root ROOT           Path to the separately cloned tsov repo
  --timeout TIMEOUT
